pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

2. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.

3. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.
   C. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.

4. Best practice when working on Middle Distance Races and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Middle Distance Races and Montage.
   B. Damage equipment used for Middle Distance Races and Montage.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Middle Distance Races and Montage.
   D. Practise Middle Distance Races and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.

6. Best practice when working on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Damage equipment used for Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Practise Roles of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   C. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.

8. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the volume
   D. Only the costume

9. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Netball.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Netball.
   C. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Netball.

10. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

11. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Remove the need for rules

12. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   B. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   D. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fabric Decoration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Verse and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Volleyball and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Red, blue, and yellow

2. A — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. C — Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. D — Practise Middle Distance Races and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. A — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. D — Practise Roles of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. C — Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. B — The speed of the music

9. C — Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. C — Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. A — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

12. B — Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Fabric Decoration; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Descant Recorder; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Verse; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Volleyball; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
